title: mcp-util-helpers runs install-time credential recon with an operator-controlled remote-exec channel (npm malware)
summary: On `npm install`, the preinstall hook (scripts/check-env.js) runs a host-reconnaissance sweep — whoami, id, uname, ip/route, ss listeners, ps, docker ps, crontab, /etc/passwd, /etc/hosts, environment variables filtered for key/token/pass/secret/api/auth, and a ~/.ssh/ listing — and POSTs the collected data to a hardcoded webhook.site bucket. The script then parses the webhook response: a `cmd` field is passed to shell exec, and a `url` field is downloaded to /tmp/.mcp-util-setup, chmod +x'd, and executed with output POSTed back, giving the operator install-time remote code execution on any machine that installs the MCP-named package. The package has been removed from the npm registry.
